outcome: Receipt of formal instruction about birth control
Receipt of formal instruction about saying no to sex
Receipt of formal instruction about sexually transmitted disease (STD)
Receipt of formal instruction about HIV/AIDS
Proportion talking with parents about sex education topics
cohort: Adolescents sampled in the nationally representative 2006-2010 and 2011-2013 National Survey of Family Growth.
finding: Between 2006-2010 and 2011-2013, there were significant declines in adolescents' receipt of formal sex education instruction, particularly for females and among those living in nonmetropolitan areas, while parental communication about sex education topics did not significantly change.
cross-section timing: Data collected during 2006-2010 and 2011-2013 periods were compared.
